name: Prefill6-calibrated external-pressure choice for Decode8
why_not_repeat_failed_threshold: The rejected sensor mixed worker counts. This refinement measures only actual pure Prefill model calls with Batch6, where the retained diagnostic shows separated ambient/cpu25 residuals for both tested profile modes.
target_cost: Remove 32-call 5/6 trial and repeated pool transitions; current adaptive is 1.093% slower than fixed5 in loaded pilot and .228% slower than fixed6 ambient. These are opportunity estimates, not a predicted or guaranteed gain.
signal: selected CPU user+nice+system tick delta minus own process CPU-clock delta, divided by actual measurement wall; do not add guest fields again

candidate_gate.quantization_budget: One difference tick per user/nice/system field per selected CPU = 18/USER_HZ; operational accounting margin, NOT a confidence interval or universal accounting bound.

resources: Same verified 6-CPU envelope; Prefill/Mixed/Unknown6, eligible 8-sequence Decode5 only when signal passes, otherwise6; preserve existing single-token Decode5
epoch: Collect 8 distinct task/slot IDs from Prefill/Mixed; initial Decode exact8; allow only monotonically shrinking known subsets thereafter; single-token old5 fallback; max256 eligible calls; reset idle/error; no crosscohort learning.
controls: same binary fixed6 and fixed5 with identical Prefill sampling
protected D adaptive candidate on same scheduler
limitations: no sensor for excluded-mask SMT interference
not a general optimizer for arbitrary batch size or hardware
a phase-gated resource policy gain does not by itself prove semantic phase labels beat every shape-based policy
